notice: All research choices below were fixed before a PASS G1 report and before labels/outcomes. Finalization may only add frozen_at, replace the pending G1 report digest, and change status to FROZEN_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.

data_sources.endpoint_or_channel: wss://fstream.binance.com public/market combined streams: btcusdt@depth@100ms, btcusdt@aggTrade, btcusdt@markPrice@1s, btcusdt@forceOrder

episode_policy.trigger: abs(D_directional_pressure) >= 1.5; pressure <= -1.5 maps to BUY reversal candidate and pressure >= 1.5 maps to SELL reversal candidate
episode_policy.overlap_policy: one active episode per instrument; reject overlap and enforce 30-second terminal cooldown

action_contract.entry_policy: research labels assume counterfactual marketable-limit IOC at the first eligible point; no fill claim and no live order

label_policy.barrier_rules: BUY and SELL candidates use symmetric 20 bps take-profit, 12 bps stop-loss and 300-second timeout; structure failure exits earlier
label_policy.same_timestamp_rule: when TP and SL cannot be ordered within one timestamp, assign SL as the conservative result
label_policy.operational_override_rule: data/risk/operational interruption censors the path; never rewrite it as TIMEOUT

execution_priors.funding_policy: use only ACTUAL markPrice fundingRate available at decision time and accrue by held duration; missing funding censors cost evaluation

evaluation_policy.calibration_rule: report reliability by predicted-probability decile; no decile may be merged after outcomes are inspected
evaluation_policy.cost_after_utility_rule: base-cost lower 95% block-bootstrap bound must exceed zero and stress-cost point estimate must be non-negative
evaluation_policy.confidence_interval_rule: 95% UTC-day block bootstrap with at least seven distinct blocks; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE/WAIT_DATA
evaluation_policy.concentration_limits: no UTC day, direction or declared liquidity state may contribute more than 40% of effective episodes

split_policy.training_calibration_policy: purged expanding-window walk-forward; fit on past only, calibrate thresholds inside each training fold, never on its test fold

hypotheses.pass_condition: relative to an empirical-class-frequency baseline, mean out-of-sample log loss improves at least 2% and Brier improves at least 1% in at least four of five folds
hypotheses.failure_condition: after sample and state gates pass, both improvements are non-positive in at least four of five folds

hypotheses.pass_condition: base-cost net utility lower 95% UTC-day block-bootstrap bound is above zero
hypotheses.failure_condition: after precision and concentration gates pass, base-cost upper 95% bound is at or below zero

hypotheses.pass_condition: stress-cost net utility point estimate is non-negative and no declared liquidity state has a negative upper 95% bound
hypotheses.failure_condition: stress-cost aggregate upper 95% bound is below zero

hypotheses.pass_condition: one-time final holdout preserves positive base-cost utility and does not worsen log loss by more than 10% versus walk-forward mean
hypotheses.failure_condition: one-time final holdout base-cost utility is non-positive or log loss worsens by more than 10%
